title: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. translated_title: 更新中的“眼睛”？学习奖励在多模态推理中的落点
translated_abstract: 多模态后训练已从宽泛的指令微调转向面向图像与视频推理的强化学习，其中结果奖励能够提升最终答案的准确性。然而，这些奖励被分配给完整生成的轨迹，而视觉证据仅在响应内部稀疏且不均匀的位置被使用。近期工作已开始通过接地信号或外部 token 级加权使多模态强化学习对 token 更加敏感。我们提出一个更具体的问题：能否从模型自身的多模态计算中推断同一轨迹级奖励的分配方式，而不依赖辅助标注器、感知模块或过程标签？我们提出 Gaze-RL，一种由表示驱动的策略优化方法，通过一个潜在的“奖励落点场”重新分配完成级优势。该落点场由内部跨模态几何结构与局部预测不确定性计算得到，为（视觉证据所在的 token）分配更大的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Gaze-RL 利用模型内部跨模态几何与局部预测不确定性构建潜在“奖励落点场”，无需外部标注器或过程标签，即可将轨迹级优势奖励重新分配到响应中视觉证据实际所在的位置，从而提升多模态强化学习的 token 敏感性。
en_tdlr: Gaze-RL redistributes trajectory-level advantages to where visual evidence actually lands within a response, using the model's internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty instead of external annotators or process labels.
